events.title: Woodstock '69 Kicks Off
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together half a million people for three days of peace, love, and music.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the iconic Woodstock festival began, defining a generation. If you could have been there, which artist would you have seen?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The world lost the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, on this day in 1977 at his Graceland estate.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, we said goodbye to the King, Elvis Presley. His music still reigns supreme. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, born today in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are unmistakable. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis and rock icon, Liam Gallagher, born today in Manchester.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Alright, our kid! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in London in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, 007 has it all. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. The legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist was born in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world commemorates the passing of Queen frontman and legendary vocalist Freddie Mercury, who died on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
